# `<e-title>`

<p><img alt="e-title screenshot" src="../__tests__/__screenshots__/typography-title--alllevels.png" width="480" /></p>

Heading element rendered as `<h1>`…`<h6>` based on `level`.

Children are used as the heading text.

> Source: [title.ts](./title.ts)

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | `1\|2\|3\|4\|5\|6` | `1` | Heading level. Out-of-range values are clamped to `1`…`6`. |
